div.div: 10 استفحشهُ [He deemed it foul, evil, bad, abominable, unseemly, immodest, lewd, or obscene: or excessively, or beyond measure, foul, &c.]. (Mgh in art. قذر.) And بِالشَّىْءِ ↓ تفحّش He deemed the thing foul, evil, &c.: or excessively, or beyond measure, foul, &c. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
